scope: Cheap read-only triage of exactly 2164 historically unreviewed shallow periodic BOI groups on 1900 sources. Original catalogue membership, labels, thresholds and running jobs unchanged. Search metrics and detailed diagnostics come from preserved exports; no detector, vetting, fitting or FPP reruns.
gaia_epoch_note: Saved Gaia DR3 query on 2026-10-10; not a fresh scene census or literature closure.

method.host_basic_screen: Reported positive paired FLAME mass/radius and RUWE<=1.4; these are priority subsets, not new catalogue or validation gates.
method.same_source_clock_flag: 1:1 or integer aliases up to factor5, period drift < supplied duration over1460days and epoch difference < supplied duration. Flags require native event-independence review; no physical denial.
method.duration_note: Grid maximum 9.6h recorded as diagnostic only, no universal duration veto.
